cat > /tmp/rel.md <<'EOF'
Refs #80.

## Release notes

### Added
- **Tools can say how the workflow log shows their calls** (#80, added in #82). A tool of a pi-durable extension can have an optional `present` field: `present.call` sets the `🔧` line and its details, and `present.result` sets the `↳` line and its details. Each field that a tool leaves out, or that fails, gets the generic form. See [Show tool calls in the workflow log](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.5.2/docs/extensions.md#show-tool-calls-in-the-workflow-log).

### Changed
- **pit calls show their label in the workflow log** (#80, changed in #81 and #82). A `typescript` call with a label shows only the label on its `🔧` line, and its details leave out pit's `// @pit:` header. This needs pit 0.36.5 or later. With an earlier pit, a call shows its first line. See [The workflow log](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.5.2/docs/how-it-works.md#the-workflow-log).
- **Each comment says how to read its thread** (#80, changed in #83). The footer of each pi-action comment is now a collapsed `🧵 This conversation is stored in git on refs/pi/threads/<number>` section with the git commands that read the thread. The job summary no longer shows these commands. The workflow log still shows them. See [Read a thread](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.5.2/docs/threads.md#read-a-thread).
EOF

git commit -q -am 'chore: release 2.5.2' 2>&1 | grep -E 'Failed|✖'; git push -q -u origin chore/release-2.5.2 2>&1 | grep -E 'Failed|error'; gh pr create --base main --head chore/release-2.5.2 --title 'chore: release 2.5.2' --body-file /tmp/rel.md
